source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Bug 1862111 describes simultaneous IMAP connection threads using an old password and causing multiple prompts or provider lockout. The accepted patch adds a monitor on nsImapIncomingServer and runs TryToLogon under it on the current connection thread. The sink proxy explicitly rejects RunLogonExclusive because a main-thread hop would break this boundary. Current code retains that design. Each connection may still need its own authentication; the lock prevents concurrent login attempts, not every later attempt.
title: Serialize IMAP login on the incoming server without proxying to the main thread
